entries.title: Stable Seat Reconnecting Interaction

entry_preconditions.description: A human controller disconnected from an existing stable seat and reconnect handling is authorized.
The same stable seat, public state, private state, and current atomic action remain reserved.

action_guards.description: The reconnecting controller is authorized for the same reserved stable seat.
Reconnect handling does not partially commit or replace a protected atomic action.

public_outputs: Same stable-seat identity and public state

privacy_contract.private_clearing_rule: No private role, faction, objective, inventory, strategy, or route knowledge enters reconnect projection.

recovery_contract.player_message: The controller remains disconnected. The same stable seat is still reserved.
Control authority changed at a safe handoff. The stable seat and state remain unchanged.

presentation_obligations.focus_restoration_rule: Return focus to the same stable-seat tile or protected active action after reconnection.

human_validation_questions: Do players understand that only the controller is reconnecting while the seat remains present?
Does grace behavior avoid panic or a false countdown during protected actions?
entries.approval_boundary: Traceability record only; no reconnect timing, controller detection, pause behavior, network logic, or runtime continuity is approved.

entries.title: Stable Seat Under Game Control Interaction

entry_preconditions.description: Reconnect grace ended or authorized departure committed and a safe handoff is available.
The game-controlled seat retains all public and private evolved state and history.

action_guards.description: Game control remains authoritative for the same stable seat at the current safe state.
No private strategy profile, allegiance, objective, or bargain willingness enters public projection.

public_outputs: Same public seat state and history

public_shared_content: Public form, location, condition, and ownership
privacy_contract.private_clearing_rule: Game-control strategy and inherited seat-private state remain inaccessible to the shared projection.

recovery_contract.player_message: Authority changed at a safe handoff. The same stable seat and evolved state remain authoritative.
The seat state changed. Current public actions and takeover availability are shown.

presentation_obligations.focus_restoration_rule: Return focus to the same game-controlled seat tile after public review closes.

human_validation_questions: Do players perceive game control as authority over the same seat rather than a replacement character?
Does the seat remain socially present without exposing private strategy?
entries.approval_boundary: Traceability record only; no surrogate strategy, decision logic, delay, takeover behavior, or runtime authority is approved.

entries.title: Public Takeover Seat Selection Interaction

entry_preconditions.description: A joining human is authorized to request control and at least one game-controlled seat is eligible.
Eligible seats expose only public-safe summaries and safe-handoff availability.

action_guards.description: The selected stable seat remains game-controlled and eligible at the safe handoff.
No private seat information is shown before one public assignment commits.
Public assignment creates takeover-pending state but does not yet grant control or private information.

public_shared_content: Public location, condition, form, and item count
privacy_contract.private_clearing_rule: No private seat state is loaded until one seat is assigned and the controlled-private handoff begins.

recovery_contract.player_message: Eligibility changed. Current public-safe takeover options are shown.
Host or seat authority changed. No takeover assignment was committed.

presentation_obligations.focus_restoration_rule: Return focus to the selected eligible seat or first current eligible seat after refresh.

human_validation_questions: Can a joining player understand transformed or injured seats from public-safe summaries alone?
Does the flow prevent private-seat shopping while making the assignment consequence clear?
entries.approval_boundary: Traceability record only; no eligibility algorithm, identity service, assignment policy, private lookup, or runtime takeover is approved.

entries.title: Inherited Private State Handoff Interaction

entry_preconditions.description: Exactly one stable seat has been assigned to the approved takeover controller.
A safe handoff is active and the shared display is covered by a neutral privacy shield.

action_guards.description: The controller remains authorized for the assigned stable seat and current handoff revision.
Required role, faction, objective, inventory, knowledge, and surrogate recap sections are acknowledged.
No private text, icon, voice, caption, reflection, or mirrored content reaches the shared display.

privacy_contract.private_clearing_rule: Clear all inherited private content before the public board is restored and human authority commits.

recovery_contract.player_message: Private inherited state cannot be shown safely. Authority was not transferred.
Authorization changed. Private content was cleared and the takeover remains uncommitted.
Acknowledgement expired. Review the current inherited state before transfer.

presentation_obligations.focus_restoration_rule: Private focus returns only to the authorized controller; otherwise clear content and retain the neutral shield.

human_validation_questions: Can the assigned player understand inherited state and surrogate history without exposing it to the room?
Is acknowledgement clearly separate from seat assignment and actual authority transfer?
entries.approval_boundary: Traceability record only; no private-display technology, security guarantee, controller authorization, inherited-state UI, or runtime handoff is approved.

entries.title: Returning Player Recap Interaction

entry_preconditions.description: A returning human is authorized for the same reserved stable seat.
No atomic action, ending calculation, transaction commit, snapshot restore, or private projection blocks handoff.

action_guards.description: The returning controller matches the same reserved stable seat and current evolved state.
Any new private state is acknowledged through an authorized private handoff before control resumes.
Game-controlled decisions remain authoritative and are not rolled back, restored, or rerolled.

private_content: New private knowledge or inherited private state for the returning seat
privacy_contract.private_clearing_rule: Any required private recap uses a separate neutral-shielded handoff before human control resumes.

recovery_contract.player_message: Return authority changed. The same stable seat and evolved state remain preserved.
Private recap cannot be shown safely. Human control has not resumed.

presentation_obligations.focus_restoration_rule: Return focus to the public recap or resume-control confirmation after any private recap.

human_validation_questions: Can a returning player understand meaningful public changes without feeling that surrogate actions were undone?
Does the flow clearly separate public recap, private recap, acknowledgement, and control transfer?
entries.approval_boundary: Traceability record only; no recap generation, event retention, private delivery, return timing, or runtime control behavior is approved.

entries.title: Restless Continuation Activation Interaction

entry_preconditions.description: A stable seat's prior public form is defeated under an authored continuation rule.
One Bell-Witness, Drowned Guide, or Lighthouse Guardian continuation form has committed.

action_guards.description: The same stable seat, history, authority, ending identity, and takeover eligibility remain.
The selected Restless form and its public action set are complete and authoritative.
No target, route answer, sacrifice, private objective, or hidden allegiance is preselected or exposed.

privacy_contract.private_clearing_rule: Private objectives, faction state, hidden targets, route answers, and sacrifice intentions remain excluded.

recovery_contract.player_message: Continuation committed. Plain-system form rules and the same stable-seat identity remain authoritative.
The Restless form and public actions remain in persistent text and transcript.

presentation_obligations.focus_restoration_rule: After acknowledgement, return focus to the same stable seat under its continuation action set.

human_validation_questions: Do players understand that the seat remains active and strategically meaningful after defeat?
Are the three Restless forms distinguishable without implying a hidden target or automatic sacrifice?
entries.approval_boundary: Traceability record only; no defeat trigger, form assignment, action set, balance, visual asset, or runtime continuation is approved.

entries.title: Invalid Action Recovery Interaction

entry_preconditions.description: An invalid, stale, unavailable, or wrong-seat action was rejected before authoritative mutation.
Current public-safe legal alternatives and deterministic focus recovery are available.

action_guards.description: The rejected action did not mutate authoritative state or consume deterministic randomness.
The rejection explanation does not reveal another seat's private state or hidden future condition.

privacy_contract.private_clearing_rule: Hidden legality causes are summarized without exposing private roles, objectives, routes, or future state.

recovery_contract.player_message: The action is stale. Current legal alternatives are shown and no state changed.
Action authority changed. Current owner and legal alternatives are shown.

presentation_obligations.focus_restoration_rule: Restore the previously selected legal option or first deterministic current alternative.

human_validation_questions: Can players recover without losing the original decision or feeling punished?
Does the public-safe explanation help without revealing hidden state or the correct future answer?
entries.approval_boundary: Traceability record only; no validation code, error taxonomy, focus timing, audio, or runtime recovery behavior is approved.

entries.title: Transcript and Replay Drawer Interaction

entry_preconditions.description: A public transcript history exists and may be opened without interrupting an atomic action.
Seat-private, faction-private, controlled-private, credential, and restricted content are absent.

action_guards.description: Replay does not re-execute a game action, consume randomness, or mutate authoritative state.
The exact public control that opened history remains a valid focus-return anchor or has a safe fallback.

privacy_contract.private_clearing_rule: Public history is built from public projections only and never aggregates private content.

recovery_contract.player_message: Transcript or replay is temporarily unavailable. The active public decision remains unchanged.
The selected public entry remains available as persistent text.

presentation_obligations.focus_restoration_rule: Return focus to the exact control that opened the transcript or the nearest safe public anchor.

human_validation_questions: Can players find and replay an important public line without changing the active decision?
Does enlarged history remain readable while clearly excluding private content?
entries.approval_boundary: Traceability record only; no transcript storage, search, replay engine, assistive behavior, or runtime drawer is approved.

entries.title: Narrative Accessibility Settings Interaction

entry_preconditions.description: Presentation settings are opened from an authorized non-atomic lobby, pause, transcript, or review state.
Caption, text, plain-language, music, voice, and reduced-density preferences are available for preview.

action_guards.description: The setting changes presentation only and does not alter mechanics, privacy, authority, randomness, legal actions, or ending eligibility.
The exact prior public context and focus-return anchor remain available.

privacy_contract.private_clearing_rule: Preview text is synthetic public-safe sample content and never reflects seat-private state.

recovery_contract.player_message: The preview could not render. The prior presentation setting remains active.
The setting and plain-system preview remain available without voice.

presentation_obligations.focus_restoration_rule: Return focus to the exact prior public control when settings close.

human_validation_questions: Can players distinguish subtitles, full captions, and plain-language presentation?
Do enlarged text and caption layout changes preserve essential controls without clipping?
entries.approval_boundary: Traceability record only; no settings storage, final ranges, fonts, caption engine, accessibility claim, or runtime presentation behavior is approved.

entries.title: Remote Join Request and Admission Queue Interaction

entry_preconditions.description: A future authorized remote requester is pending under a host-review admission policy.
Admission approval remains separate from spectator access, seat eligibility, private handoff, and control authority.

action_guards.description: The acting host remains authorized to resolve the current request revision.
The requested role, compatibility warnings, and seat availability remain current.
Approval does not assign a stable seat, reveal private state, or grant control authority.

privacy_contract.private_clearing_rule: Admission projection excludes account credentials, private seat state, roles, factions, objectives, inventory, infection, bargains, and history.

recovery_contract.player_message: The request changed. Current admission options and compatibility are shown.
The request cannot be reviewed completely. No admission decision was committed.

presentation_obligations.focus_restoration_rule: Return focus to the current request or next pending request after resolution.

human_validation_questions: Can the host distinguish admission, spectator access, eligible-seat review, and actual authority transfer?
Does the queue remain safe and understandable without interrupting critical local play or exposing private data?
entries.approval_boundary: Traceability record only; no network service, identity system, invitation policy, spectator mode, security control, or runtime remote flow is approved.
